articles.electric.title: Electric Propulsion: The Engine of a New Space Era
articles.electric.summary: Electric propulsion converts electrical power to thrust via ion and Hall thrusters, reshaping space exploration.
articles.electric.description: Electric propulsion represents a transformative leap for spaceflight, accelerating propellant via electrostatic or electromagnetic fields. Ion engines stand out for high efficiency and specific impulse, ideal for long-duration missions. By 2019, more than 500 spacecraft had adopted electric propulsion—missions such as NASA's Dawn and ESA's SMART-1 showcased its capability. Continuous low-thrust acceleration enables complex maneuvers and journeys to Mars and beyond.
